parent_objective: run positive-neighborhood bounded replay smoke on M1470 selected candidates
blocked_by: bounded replay has not yet been run on positive-neighborhood preflight-pass candidates
supersedes: preflight-only evidence as final outcome evidence

public_gates: M1472 must run bounded replay with --candidate-step-column source_step
M1472 must not train run PPO promote use private holdout export corpus or change actor inputs
M1472 must report selected candidate rows actual replay rows history positives control positives normal failures and unique-key diagnostics
forbidden_shortcuts: do not treat a smoke positive as promotion evidence
do not claim level3 self-identification from one public replay smoke

workflow_synthesis.evidence_increment: runs actual bounded replay smoke over deduplicated positive-neighborhood preflight-pass candidates
workflow_synthesis.claim_scope: bounded replay smoke only; no training, PPO, promotion, private holdout, corpus export, paper-level or level3 self-identification claim
stop_condition: stop if candidate_step_column is not source_step
stop if training_started or ppo_used or promoted is true
fallback_plan: route to replay result audit if smoke completes
route to replay schema audit if smoke aborts before actual replay rows
workflow_synthesis.synthesis_trigger: M1471 admits positive-neighborhood bounded replay smoke

allowed_updates: status queue scoreboard research log and review
one follow-up replay result audit manifest
next_stage_criteria: replay smoke completed or failed clearly
actual replay rows and outcome counts are recorded

self_id_evidence_discipline.current_frame_substitution_risk: M1472 can only make bounded public replay claims; one smoke cannot establish level3 self-identification.
history_necessity_tests: normal history versus selected history variants in bounded replay
reset and zero-current controls emitted by replay probe
self_id_evidence_discipline.negative_result_policy: If no history positives appear, audit source/replay design rather than weakening the claim standard.
allowed_claims: bounded replay smoke result and row counts
no promotion, corpus export, training, PPO, private-holdout, paper-level result or level3 self-identification claim

hypothesis: A bounded replay smoke over M1470 deduplicated positive-neighborhood candidates can test whether the M1461 singleton expands to a broader outcome-sensitive surface.
failure_criteria: run starts training PPO promotion private holdout corpus export or actor-input change

commands.name: positive_neighborhood_bounded_replay_smoke
commands.command: OMP_NUM_THREADS=1 MKL_NUM_THREADS=1 PYTHONPATH=src python -m autodrift.bounded_relocation_replay_probe --checkpoint runs/m1362_bidirectional_active_set_interpolation_preflight/checkpoints/alpha_0_1.pt --config configs/m1419_warmup_gate_invasiveness_retune_source_wave.json --candidate-rows runs/m1470_positive_neighborhood_preflight_smoke/selected_candidate_rows.csv --geometry-aware-selector --max-candidate-rows 96 --per-capability-pair-cap 16 --per-seed-cap 24 --per-reveal-bucket-cap 12 --per-variant-cap 48 --history-length 56 --recent-window-length 4 --max-continuation-steps 48 --min-margin-gap 0.02 --min-sequence-action-l2 0.025 --min-source-body-x 4.0 --candidate-step-column source_step --device cpu --run-dir runs/m1472_positive_neighborhood_bounded_replay_smoke

decision_rule: M1472 passes if positive-neighborhood bounded replay smoke completes and records actual replay rows without training or promotion.
